explanation: Requested W = 1.2 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold of 1.4861 GeV (approximately M_proton + M_eta). At this W the eta+p final state cannot physically exist, so no radiative correction can be computed. The exclurad_preflight_check tool confirms FAIL on w_threshold and also on table_coverage (the EtaMAID-2023 lookup table only spans W in [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV, so the hadronic model has no data at W = 1.2 GeV either). This is a physical impossibility, not a formatting issue, so no input file was generated and W was not silently altered. A valid eta-channel point would require W >= ~1.4961 GeV (safely above threshold and inside table coverage) at the same Q2 = 1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*) = 0, phi* = 90 deg, or the user could instead request a different reaction channel (e.g. pi+ electroproduction, threshold 1.079 GeV) for which W = 1.2 GeV is physically allowed.
